sentences.en: The following days were serene and rich in diversions.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几天平静而充满娱乐活动。

sentences.en: A diversion is in effect around roadworks in the city centre.
sentences.zh: 市中心正在进行道路施工，附近有临时交通改道。

sentences.en: I have a lot of time for diversions.
sentences.zh: 我有很多时间用来消遣。

senses.zh: 转移，转向；消遣，娱乐；分流，改道；偏离；转移注意力的事物

mnemonic: 词根记忆：di（离开）+vers（转）+ion →转向，转移
